data.body:
[P2] Preserve distinct emission identities when truncating timestamps

With `emit_mode="on-change"`, the worker can take a RUNNING snapshot before a terminal snapshot is built within the same millisecond. Previously distinct timestamps such as `.784119Z` and `.784999Z` now both become `.784Z`. `SQSExporter` derives its FIFO deduplication ID from `executionArn:emittedAt`, so the terminal message is silently suppressed; `DynamoDBExporter` uses the same pair as its history key, so separate snapshots overwrite each other. Scheduler coalescing does not prevent this once the worker has taken the first snapshot. Keep the fixed-width timestamps, but use a separate unique emission identity for deduplication and history keys, with regression tests covering two distinct snapshots emitted within one millisecond.
